A1.justification: Both readable 11-page PDFs describe BTP and support comparison of all supplied text, equations, figures, and tables. Neither contains appendices; supplementary material referenced in Section 4.3 is not included in either supplied file.

before.justification: v1 reports original BTP evaluations on Real3D-AD and Anomaly-ShapeNet, including cross-category experiments, ablations, and localization visualizations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and reports revised localization scores in Tables 3–5.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same BTP architecture, GFCM and MGFEM components, hybrid prompts, anomaly scoring, and joint training objectives.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate object-level detection and point-level localization on Real3D-AD and Anomaly-ShapeNet, with the same category coverage and cross-category scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1 and 3 and Figure 3. No baseline is added, removed, or substantively revised.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 retain the same metrics, preprocessing, encoder, and one-category training protocol. The ablation configurations also match. No protocol change is documented to explain the revised PRO scores.

E4.justification: Tables 4–5 revise PRO evidence within the existing module, loss, and input-point ablations. In particular, removing global supervision now outperforms the full model on PRO for both datasets. The tested questions and configurations remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report averaging over 10 independent runs with different seeds and retain the same plus/minus reporting practice in Table 3. Revised uncertainty magnitudes accompany changed results, without changes to statistical procedures.

E6.justification: Table 3 changes BTP's P-PRO from 81.9±2.7 to 55.5±2.6 on Real3D-AD and from 82.2±1.2 to 55.8±2.6 on Anomaly-ShapeNet. Tables 4–5 also revise PRO values substantially. Table 4 reverses the full-model versus no-global-loss ranking on PRO. Other metrics and baseline scores remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–8 are unchanged. Neither version adds theoretical guarantees, assumptions, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about PLM-based zero-shot detection, geometric alignment, joint learning, and superior localization. The revised scores do not prompt any narrowing of these claims.

C2.justification: The generalization explanations, module interpretations, and future-work discussion are unchanged. Section 4.4 still states that the full loss configuration achieves the best results, without qualifying this interpretation to reflect the revised PRO ranking.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, software, and the promised code-release link remain unchanged. No explanation or reproducibility information is added for the score revisions.

R1.justification: Both versions retain the same 58 references and the same positioning relative to VLM-based approaches, ULIP, and PLANE.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp changes, and numerical substitutions update existing results sentences. There is no substantive prose rewriting, terminology change, or section reorganization.

P2.justification: All three figures and five tables retain their placement, captions, structure, and styling. Numerical replacements within the existing tables do not constitute a display or layout revision.

improvement.justification: Unlike v1, v2's Table 4 no longer supports Section 4.4's claim that the full configuration is best on PRO: removing global loss yields 59.1 versus 55.5 on Real3D-AD and 57.3 versus 55.8 on Anomaly-ShapeNet. Retaining the interpretation without qualification creates a limited loss of internal consistency. The PDFs do not explain or validate the numerical revisions as corrections; lower scores alone are not the basis for this judgment.
